title: Kissed Earthy Thai Peanuts Boat Noodles
description: Earthy and nostalgic Thai dish featuring peanuts and spherified elements, served in a boat noodle form, perfect for those who prefer no onion and no garlic in their meals.

ingredients.name: spherified peanut balls
ingredients.notes: made from peanut butter and sodium alginate

instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
Prepare the spherified peanut balls by mixing peanut butter with sodium alginate and dropping the mixture into a bath of water and calcium chloride.
In a large pot, combine the coconut milk, peanut sauce, fish sauce, and lime juice, and bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Add the cooked noodles to the pot and stir to combine with the sauce.
Add the blanched bean sprouts and chopped Thai basil to the pot and stir to combine.
To assemble the dish, place some noodles into a boat-shaped bowl, followed by a few spherified peanut balls and some sauce.
Garnish with additional Thai basil and bean sprouts if desired.
Store any leftovers in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
Reheat the leftovers gently over low heat before serving.
